consumer.effect: Set every other existing attached Animation.mCanceled(+0x63)=true at0x180299f23

Constant.Init0x1802b1ae0 likewise calls Defaults at0x1802b1b05, assigns data/location, Attach at0x1802b1b27, then base Init0x180291b80 calls actual InitData at0x180291bf7. portable_boundary.screen: ScreenAnimationWorld marks own old child allocations canceled, preserves old primary through this pass, invokes required cross-manager provider before assigning the new primary.
portable_boundary.action: ActionEffectWorld.cancelAllAttachedForAttach matches actual attached owner/lifetime, skips current primary, detached, GUI null-Thing associations and LightControllers, preflights unsupported DisableOwnerInput release, marks registry cancellation without changing PreventChain.
portable_boundary.unsupported: Admission remains bounded: CancelAllAttached with new ChildAnimation is rejected; a screen child using CancelAllAttached is also rejected because it can cancel its still-initializing parent before Thing.mAnimation is assigned.
